english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hereditary nobles or the noble class.
This is the all-purpose choice for the hereditary or privileged noble class.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an aristocrat or member of the nobility, including a male nobleman.
Use this for a titled noble in a peerage or a comparable historical noble context, rather than for an ordinary equal or contemporary.

examples.english: That painting shows a group from the aristocracy.
